methodology.text: The validation score was derived by cross-referencing documented pain points in agency approval workflows against the lack of verified purchase-intent signals, ensuring that identified market gaps are weighted against the actual probability of immediate revenue conversion.

executive_summary.text: While there is clear evidence of operational friction caused by fragmented feedback loops and version control issues in agency workflows, the current market lacks evidence of urgent purchase intent or willingness to pay for a dedicated solution.

The demand for structured audit trails and centralized approval systems is well-documented, yet the absence of direct commitment signals suggests that potential buyers may be satisfied with existing, albeit inefficient, email-based processes.
